answer: Shard work by beacon, not choice. Each epoch every key draws one shard out of S from a public seed and its address: a quartz grain it cannot pick or trade. A claim pays only if the key worked inside it. One operator staffs one shard, so N cloned heads need N operators awake at once, or go unpaid. The draw is also the detector: independent assignment puts co-occurrence on a birthday curve, so two heads that keep landing on the same dune are not independent. No new attestation; the ledger holds the collision. Odds grow as N squared over S, while one honest key pays the same fee on any knoll.
